final: SELECT m.college, SUM(i.amount) AS total_income, CAST(SUM(i.amount) AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(i2.amount) FROM income i2 JOIN member mb2 ON i2.link_to_member = mb2.member_id JOIN major m2 ON mb2.link_to_major = m2.major_id) AS fraction FROM income i JOIN member mb ON i.link_to_member = mb.member_id JOIN major m ON mb.link_to_major = m.major_id GROUP BY m.college
